newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain Telefonica sale proceeds $4.47 bln.
newsitem.headline: Spain Telefonica sale proceeds $4.47 bln.

text.p: Total proceeds for the Spanish government from the sale of its last 20.9 percent stake in Telefonica was $4.47 billion, the global coordinators of the privatisation said on Wednesday.

The final amount entering state coffers (around 630 billion pesetas) will deduct around 3 billion pesetas for advertising costs, and a further 13 billion pesetas for commissions paid to the sale managers.
This morning the coordinators exercised their over-allotment, or green-shoe, option because of the strong demand for shares, increasing the offering by 19,942,667 ordinary shares.
Global coordinators were Morgan Stanley, Argentaria, Banco Bilbao Vizcaya and La Caixa savings bank.
